text:
A: Hiya! Oh, it's you, with the dog photo! I'm Kerry.
B: Hiya, I'm Ffion. Oh, I said your dog was cute, on the photo bit. Sorry, is it a dog on your settee?
A: Yeah, that's Alfie! He's still there now, look, he's not moved all day. Bless him. Where are you, love?
B: Wrexham. In North Wales.
A: Oh, lovely. I'm Chatham, Kent. Is this your last one? I've lost count.
B: I think it's my fourth. I'm getting a bit less nervous now, to be honest.
A: Oh, me too. I've just had one where I got a whole lesson on my salon accounts, I've got the notes here, look. Product cost per client. I'm very proud of myself.
B: Oh, are you a hairdresser?
A: Yeah, I've got a little salon with my friend, four chairs. I still do my own clients three days a week. What about you, are you at uni? I thought you looked like you'd been studying, sorry, that sounds rude.
B: No, it's true! I'm in final year, occupational therapy. I'm on placement on an older adults' ward, and then I work in a café on Saturdays, so I'm sort of shattered all the time.
A: Oh, bless you. That's a lot. My juniors are about your age and I'm always telling them to get some sleep.
B: I'm meant to be in bed by ten but I just end up on TikTok.
A: Oh, we all do that. I lie there scrolling house accounts on Instagram till midnight. Darren thinks I'm mad. What d'you do to switch off then?
B: Erm, I do my nails at home, mostly. And telly. Love Island when it's on.
A: Shut up, Love Island! Did you watch last night's?
B: Yeah! I couldn't believe the recoupling.
A: I know! Our family group chat went off. My mum doesn't even watch it and she was messaging. Who d'you want to win?
B: Erm, I don't really mind, I just like the drama, to be honest.
A: That's the right answer. It's the drama, isn't it? And your nails look lovely, I noticed that. Do you do gels?
B: Just normal polish, I'm not very good at gels. I keep meaning to try.
A: Oh, you should. One of my girls does them in the salon. Erm, so where d'you go on holiday? I always ask everyone that, sorry.
B: Tenerife, twice. The same hotel both times.
A: No! I've just booked Tenerife for September! I love knowing where everything is, d'you know what I mean? I can't be doing with anywhere too different.
B: Yeah, exactly. I went to Benidorm once and I hated it, I was so stressed.
A: Oh, I'd be the same. I'm terrible with flights, I'm a bag of nerves until we're at the hotel and I've got a drink in my hand. Do you eat out much there, or just the buffet?
B: Mostly the buffet. I'm quite fussy. Like at Nando's I always get lemon and herb, chips and garlic bread.
A: Every time? That's me! Lemon and herb, I don't even look at the menu.
B: My friend Sian always tries to make me have something spicy.
A: Oh, don't let her. You stick to your guns. So when you've finished, d'you want to stay near home?
B: Yeah, I want to work for the health board round Wrexham, so I can be near my mum.
A: Oh, that's lovely. My whole family lives within twenty minutes of each other, and I wouldn't change it. Sunday dinner at my mum's, every week...
